breaking.change: Ease columns store a canonical 20-byte tag and parameter payload, not a named-only u32 enum index. Camera blendEase, soloEase and blendCurve accept the full shared timing vocabulary.
breaking.fix: Use Ease strings for every field; rebuild cooked scenes and start new recordings/snapshots containing Ease columns. Raw Uint32Array views have stride 5.

added.summary: Bezier controls and step count/position survive ECS hashes, snapshots, scene cook/save, probe edits and both hosts. The shared parser/evaluator now lives in og-core and remains exported by og-tween.
